shellCommands.command: npm test && node --check server.js && node --check lib/store.js && node --check lib/html.js

set -e
curl -sS -D - -o /tmp/home.html http://127.0.0.1:3456/
echo '--- HOME BODY ---'
rg -n "Currently reading|Finished|Add a book" /tmp/home.html
echo '--- ADD ---'
curl -sS -D - -o /dev/null -X POST http://127.0.0.1:3456/books --data-urlencode 'title=Kindred' --data-urlencode 'author=Octavia E. Butler' --data-urlencode 'notes=Reread notes <script>'
LOC=$(curl -sS -D - -o /tmp/book.html -X POST http://127.0.0.1:3456/books --data-urlencode 'title=The Dispossessed' --data-urlencode 'author=Ursula K. Le Guin' --data-urlencode 'notes=Ambiguous utopia' | awk 'tolower($1)=="location:" {print $2}' | tr -d '\r')
echo "LOCATION=$LOC"
curl -sS -o /tmp/book.html "http://127.0.0.1:3456$LOC"
echo '--- BOOK PAGE ---'
rg -n "The Dispossessed|Ursula|Ambiguous|Mark as finished|script" /tmp/book.html
echo '--- FINISH ---'
curl -sS -D - -o /dev/null -X POST "http://127.0.0.1:3456${LOC}/finish"
curl -sS -o /tmp/finished.html "http://127.0.0.1:3456$LOC"
rg -n "Finished|Mark as finished" /tmp/finished.html
echo '--- HOME AFTER ---'
curl -sS http://127.0.0.1:3456/ | rg -n "Kindred|The Dispossessed|Currently reading|Finished"
echo '--- MISSING ---'
curl -sS -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' http://127.0.0.1:3456/books/nope
echo '--- JSON ---'
cat data/books.json

set -e
curl -sS -D - -o /tmp/home.html http://127.0.0.1:3456/
echo '--- HOME BODY ---'
grep -n -E 'Currently reading|Finished|Add a book' /tmp/home.html
echo '--- ADD ---'
LOC=$(curl -sS -D - -o /dev/null -X POST http://127.0.0.1:3456/books --data-urlencode 'title=Kindred' --data-urlencode 'author=Octavia E. Butler' --data-urlencode 'notes=Reread notes <script>' | awk 'tolower($1)=="location:" {print $2}' | tr -d '\r')
echo "KINDRED=$LOC"
LOC2=$(curl -sS -D - -o /dev/null -X POST http://127.0.0.1:3456/books --data-urlencode 'title=The Dispossessed' --data-urlencode 'author=Ursula K. Le Guin' --data-urlencode 'notes=Ambiguous utopia' | awk 'tolower($1)=="location:" {print $2}' | tr -d '\r')
echo "DISP=$LOC2"
curl -sS -o /tmp/book.html "http://127.0.0.1:3456$LOC2"
echo '--- BOOK PAGE ---'
grep -n -E 'The Dispossessed|Ursula|Ambiguous|Mark as finished|script' /tmp/book.html
echo '--- FINISH ---'
curl -sS -D - -o /dev/null -X POST "http://127.0.0.1:3456${LOC}/finish"
curl -sS -o /tmp/finished.html "http://127.0.0.1:3456$LOC"
grep -n -E 'Finished|Mark as finished' /tmp/finished.html
echo '--- HOME AFTER ---'
curl -sS http://127.0.0.1:3456/ | grep -n -E 'Kindred|The Dispossessed|Currently reading|Finished'
echo '--- MISSING ---'
curl -sS -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' http://127.0.0.1:3456/books/nope
echo '--- JSON ---'
cat data/books.json
